llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The Matcher struct in prometheus/model/labels/matcher.go already compiles regex at construction via NewMatcher, but needs a package-level cache and lazy compilation for struct literals to avoid re-compilation. The Matches method signature must change from (bool) to (bool, error) to surface regex errors, requiring updates to all callers across prometheus, thanos, and loki to handle the new error return and propagate it through the observability stack.

FILES:
- prometheus/model/labels/matcher.go — Definition of Matcher struct and Matches method; requires adding regex cache and changing method signature to return error
- prometheus/tsdb/querier.go — Primary caller of Matches; multiple call sites need error handling and callback signature updates
- prometheus/tsdb/index/index.go — PostingsForLabelMatching interface uses func(string) bool callback; must change to func(string) (bool, error)
- prometheus/tsdb/head_read.go — headIndexReader.PostingsForLabelMatching delegates to interface; callback type must change
- prometheus/model/labels/test_utils.go — Selector.Matches calls m.Matches; must handle (bool, error) return
- prometheus/model/labels/matcher_test.go — Tests call Matches directly; must update to handle error return
- thanos/pkg/compactv2/modifiers.go — delModifierSeriesSet.Next calls m.Matches; must handle (bool, error) return
- loki/pkg/util/matchers.go — SplitFiltersAndMatchers calls matcher.Matches(""); must propagate error
- loki/pkg/logql/log/label_filter.go — StringLabelFilter.Process calls s.Matches; must handle error return
- mimir/pkg/ingester/activeseries/model/matchers.go — NewMatchers and labelsMatchers.Matches call m.Matches; must propagate errors
